paragraphs.source_zh: “依您之见……”

paragraphs.source_en: “In my view, those who made our lord so indecisive today must be that self-important Masanobu and men of Kazumasa's ilk. Yes, it must have been Kazumasa. That cur did not even dare attack Inuyama Castle when its defenses were empty.” With that, Tadakatsu strode angrily straight into Makino Sōjirō's large tent.

units.source_zh: 说着，忠胜愤愤地径直走进牧野总次郎的大帐。

paragraphs.source_zh: “依我之见，今日让主公患得患失的，定是自以为是的正信、数正之流。对，定是数正，那厮连进攻防守空虚的犬山城都不敢。”说着，忠胜愤愤地径直走进牧野总次郎的大帐。

paragraphs.source_en: By this time, Hideyoshi had already returned from Nagakute to Ryūsenji and, just as Mizuno Tadashige had anticipated, was urgently summoning his commanders and soldiers to deliberate an attack on Obata Castle.
